='''The Warlord'''=

The followers of Rallos Zek believe in the survival of the strong and extinction of the weak. In the heat of battle is the only place enlightenment can be gained. The universe was formed by conflict and in conflict it will end. The victors will feast upon the remains of the fallen. No respect or regard is given to the dead, for if they were worthy, their hearts would still pump blood through their veins and not upon the soil of Norrath. Followers of Zek are almost exclusively [[Warrior]]s.

==Followers of Rallos Zek==

Rallos Zek created the [[Ogre]]s, [[Orc]]s, [[Goblin]]s, and [[Giant]]s, and they are his primary followers, with the [[Shamen of War]] in Oggok being especially loyal.
